parameters.name: CharacterType
parameters.description:
The architecture of the instance. For more information, see [Overview](~~86132~~). Valid values:

*   **logic**: The instance is a cluster master-replica instance or a read/write splitting instance.
*   **normal**: The instance is a standard master-replica instance.

parameters.name: Engine
parameters.description: The database engine that is run on the instance. Set the value to **Redis**.

parameters.name: EngineVersion
parameters.description: The major version of the instance. Valid values: **4.0**, **5.0**, **6.0**, and **7.0**.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the instance. You can call the [DescribeInstances](~~473778~~) operation to query the IDs of instances.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description:
The ID of the resource group to which the instance belongs. You can call the [ListResourceGroups](~~158855~~) operation to query the IDs of resource groups.

>  You can also query the ID of a resource group in the Resource Management console. For more information, see [View the basic information of a resource group](~~151181~~).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun r-kvstore describe-parameter-templates --character-type logic --engine Redis --engine-version 5.0 --resource-group-id rg-acfmyiu4ekp0000 --instance-id r-bp1zxszhcgatnx0000 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun r-kvstore DescribeParameterTemplates --region cn-hangzhou --EngineVersion '5.0' --ResourceGroupId 'rg-acfmyiu4ekp0000' --InstanceId 'r-bp1zxszhcgatnx0000' --CharacterType logic --Engine Redis
